visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a dark red jersey with sponsor logos and a black bag strap across his chest sits in a modern, brightly lit indoor lounge with wooden partitions and soft yellow lighting. He speaks directly to the camera with a wide smile and expressive facial gestures. (2) Rapid cuts show the same man on a sunny beach in a white shirt, then reaching for bananas in a lush green plantation, and finally covered in gray mud while standing in a thermal pool outdoors. (3) The man in the red jersey sits at a small table inside a luxurious aircraft cabin with two other men; one is wearing a dark jacket with a 'TAIWAN' patch. They are looking at a tablet screen showing a global map. (4) The scene shifts to the man in the red jersey standing outside a modern building with glass and metal architecture under a clear blue sky. Yellow captions appear at the bottom of the frame. (5) In a brightly lit clinical setting, the man sits next to a woman holding a small child; they all smile at the camera while gesturing. (6) A group of children in yellow and green uniforms stand in a line outdoors under hanging flags of different nations, performing a synchronized rhythmic movement. (7) The man stands in a warehouse filled with large white sacks, holding up one sack that features a colorful graphic with the text 'LOVE FROM TAIWAN'. (8) At night on a paved outdoor plaza, the man embraces another man in a striped shirt while others walk in the background under artificial street lighting. (9) The man stands in a busy outdoor fair or market during the day, holding an orange ice pop and gesturing toward the crowd and stalls behind him. (10) A group of men in a field look at a poster featuring various types of watermelons; large watermelons are laid out on a table in the foreground. (11) The man talks to a young woman under a large tree in a park-like setting with many people in the background. (12) The man stands in an outdoor courtyard at dusk, talking to another man wearing a black t-shirt with a white graphic. (13) The man walks along a waterfront path next to a body of water with buildings in the distance, waving his hand toward the camera before walking away.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional travel vlog documenting a diplomatic mission led by Taiwan's Minister of Foreign Affairs and a popular creator. It aims to showcase Taiwan's international contributions through technical missions, humanitarian aid, and cultural exchange in allied countries, presented in an accessible social-media-friendly format.
